KB11.title: Cotton Drip Irrigation and Alternate Furrow Scheduling
KB11.content: Cotton requires 600-800 mm of water throughout its cycle. Under water-scarce conditions, alternate furrow irrigation saves 30-35% water without yield reduction. Drip irrigation with inline drippers (2 LPH at 40 cm spacing) achieves 90% water use efficiency. Critical irrigation stages: Square initiation, flowering, and boll formation.
KB11.citation: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY) Technical Bulletin 2025

KB11.title: Alternate Wetting and Drying (AWD) in Paddy
KB11.content: AWD saves up to 30% irrigation water and reduces methane emissions by 45%. Insert a 30 cm perforated PVC pipe (10 cm diameter) into the paddy field to a depth of 15 cm. Irrigate only when water level inside the tube drops 15 cm below soil surface. Maintain continuous 2-5 cm standing water only from panicle initiation to flowering.

KB12.title: Sustainable Crop Rotation Systems for Cotton
KB12.content: Continuous sole cropping of Bt cotton increases pink bollworm infestation and depletes deep soil potassium. Best rotations: Cotton - Greengram (relay), Cotton - Bengalgram, or Cotton intercropped with Redgram / Pigeonpea in 6:1 or 8:2 row ratio. Legume nodules fix 40-60 kg atmospheric nitrogen per hectare.
KB12.citation: ICAR-Indian Institute of Farming Systems Research (IIFSR) 2025

KB12.title: Rice-Fallow Pulse Crop Intensification
KB12.content: In rice-fallows, broadcast Blackgram (Urdbean) or Greengram (Mungbean) seeds @ 16-18 kg/acre into standing rice crop 3-4 days before paddy harvest (relay sowing/utera). Utilizes residual soil moisture and adds organic nitrogen.

KB13.title: Integrated Weed Management in Cotton Fields
KB13.content: Critical period of crop-weed competition in cotton is 15 to 60 DAS. Apply Pendimethalin 38.7% CS @ 700 ml/acre or Pendimethalin 30% EC @ 1.0-1.3 liters/acre as pre-emergence spray within 48 hours of sowing. Follow with hand weeding and intercultivation with bullock or tractor drawn danti/guntaka at 30 and 50 DAS. For post-emergence broadleaf weeds, Pyrithiobac-sodium 10% EC @ 250-300 ml/acre can be applied at 20-25 DAS.

KB13.title: Paddy Weed Management in DSR and Puddled Fields
KB13.content: In transplanted rice, apply Pretilachlor 50% EC @ 500 ml/acre with safener within 3 days after transplanting mixed with sand or spray. In direct seeded rice (DSR), apply Bispyribac-sodium 10% SC @ 80-100 ml/acre at 15-20 DAS when weeds are at 2-3 leaf stage.
KB13.citation: ICAR-DWR National Rice Weed Management Advisory 2025
